0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who have not yet played a game this season. Spencer Jones is listed as day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision for Denver. The Nuggets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, but they won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance of winning.
